added_lines: 703 feasts of all saints and all souls this sunday (1st november) the church celebrates the feast of all saints. annual november novena for the dead - all are encouraged to join in the annual novena for the holy souls beginning on the feast of all saints until the 9th november. novena cards, and candles (£4 each) for lighting on your family graves during the days of the novena are available in each of the churches this weekend. monday 2nd november , on the feast of all souls there will be a special mass commemorating all those who have died in the parish since last november in the church of the immaculate conception, beragh at 7.30 pm. all are encouraged to come and join in prayer for the happy repose of the souls of all who have died. november dead lists should be handed in next weekend. masses will be offered throughout the year for all those enrolled on the november dead list. offertory promise 25th october 2026 envelopes: £ 1,111.10 loose collection: £ 245.24 candles: £ 120.11st patrick’s cathedral restoration: £ 83.00 peter’s pence: £ 16.00 mission sunday: £ 192.00 priest’s dues: £ 260.00 total: £ 2,027.45 amount received by standing order payments during the month of september was £2,729.67. thank you to all those parishioners who continue to support the parish. parish christmas carol service our parish christmas carol service will take place on monday 14th december at 7.00 pm. rehearsals will begin on monday 9th november. we warmly welcome all singers and musicians, both new and returning, to come along and take part as we prepare for this special celebration of christmas. do this in memory programme the parents of p4 pupils who are preparing for first holy communion this year are invited to a meeting in st oliver plunkett’s primary school this tuesday 3rd november at 7.00 pm. beragh
